findings: The union of incidence sets over an actual vertex cover contains every actual edge. Union cardinality and each covered degree give |E|≤k|S| without restricting degrees outside S.
Independence of old vertices makes the new vertices a cover; their degree at most two yields |E|≤2(N−|old|)≤2N.
The chosen native-distance preserver is literally G on the same vertices, so preservation is exact for every terminal pair, including disconnected pairs. Under 2N<T² its size is strictly below T².
scope: A graph-shape obstruction for the full-private-subdivision family under the stated cover/degree hypotheses. No explicit subdivision execution is constructed, and arbitrary graph existence is not refuted.
successor_change: Only removed unused incidence simp lemma in the first endpoint u-cover proof; theorem statements and executable definitions unchanged.
